body.content: Speculative mechanism: What if 'passing through the exact center' is interpreted as infinitesimally offset to avoid perfect concurrence? This maps to general position, yielding 11 pieces. The problem's phrasing 'exact center' implies concurrency, but this tests the semantic ambiguity of 'exact'.
body.why_keep_this: Explores the transition between concurrency (8 pieces) and general position (11 pieces).
